name: 365 Bridgewater NJ

profile.reading: Per 365 Data Centers own site, this Bridgewater, New Jersey facility sits at 999 Frontier Rd and totals 25,600 square feet of data center space, with 2.3 MW of power installed and 20 MW total available on site for future expansion. The facility is audited to PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 1, SOC 2, SSAE 18, and ISAE 3402 standards. No Tier classification is published.
